//: Committed defaults, meant to run out of the box against the development server in
docker-compose.yml. HybridMeld has its own database on it, 'hybridmeld', which the
first migration creates:
docker compose up -d db
dotnet ef database update --project src/HybridMeld.Core --startup-project src/HybridMeld.Server
dotnet run --project src/HybridMeld.Server -- hybrid seed-regimes
The connection strings below are throwaway (user sancmeld, password sancmeld, port
55432, all published in docker-compose.yml). NEVER edit them to hold real ones; point
at your own server from outside the repository:
development  -> dotnet user-secrets set "ConnectionStrings:HybridMeld" "..."
docker/prod  -> environment variable ConnectionStrings__HybridMeld=...
local file   -> appsettings.Development.json (git-ignored)
SancMeldAccounts is the sanctions database: the hybrid grant (is_allowed_for_hybrid),
the regimes to seed and the targets of sanctions links are read from it, nothing is
written. Without it every verified address may use the workspace and nothing can be
seeded. PepMeld is the PEP database, read only to name a linked person.
Auth:GoogleClientId is empty, so only API keys sign in. Fill it in per deployment with
the same client id SancMeld uses:
HybridMeld__Auth__GoogleClientId=1234-abcd.apps.googleusercontent.com
Every key under Logging:LogLevel is read as a category name, so no comment can live
inside that section.
